scope: Management visual inspection of actual desktop and mobile screenshots; complements functional browser reports and independent delivery audits. Not a claim of physical-device testing or pixel-perfect equivalence.

designs.observation: Desktop two-column FAQ and mobile stacked categories, contact card and accordion render with readable text.
Desktop two pricing cards and mobile stacked card render with the specified dark presentation.
Desktop three glass cards and mobile horizontally scrollable card presentation render over the supplied video.
Desktop and mobile show real image rows. Delivery preview scrolls to the gallery below the intentionally empty hero; Celestia substitution is explicitly documented.
Desktop and mobile display decoded video behind real WISA DOM text and controls. Same supplied footage transcoded from HEVC to H.264; conversion details recorded in public/assets/provenance.json.
Desktop and mobile show the refraction canvas, real form controls and video background. Worker report also records changing canvas pixels.
Real video-backed hero, readable responsive headings, product card and cart affordance render correctly at both sizes. Worker also tested shopping controls and all three video sections.
Desktop and mobile show supplied sprout video, Recoleta heading and readable responsive content.
Dotted strip, navigation columns and CSS brand render at both viewports; mobile wordmark scales to avoid clipping.
Supplied video hero and shaped frame render at both viewports; headline and CTA are readable.
Video-to-canvas DNA hero and serif accent render at both viewports; scroll phases independently tested by original session.

Real red DOM section and signature render; bottom artwork is an isolated still-derived animated approximation because the source video is disabled. Original motion and full aspect ratio are unavailable and documented.
Chart cards, tabs and numeric bars render at both viewports; mobile tabs intentionally scroll horizontally.

Desktop split headline, mobile full-width video, destination gallery and mobile tour panel inspected. All seven routes, search/client navigation and true custom 404 responses separately verified online.
Cabin video, desktop booking panel and mobile stacked content render with readable headings; missing original vectors and embedded font data are documented.
Real video-backed hero, readable text/icons and mobile navigation render at both viewports.
Three actual video cards align at the bottom on desktop and stack on mobile, with readable statistics; original session resumed after a confirmed transport failure.
Black hero, responsive headline and supplied animated video render on desktop and mobile; local font and mobile menu verified by original session.
